steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:4180/ and sign in with email bench@example.com and password bench-pass-1234. Then create a new ticket titled exactly '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket', filling in any required fields the form demands (use sensible placeholder values for anything else). After submitting, wait for the list/detail view to refresh and confirm the ticket exists. Report the ticket's title, its current status, and any other fields shown on its detail view.

On the ticket detail view for ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_id}}), add a part named exactly '{{runid}} RD Part A' with cost 100 and markup 25. Fill any other required fields the part form demands with sensible values. After saving, wait for the view to refresh and confirm the part appears in the ticket's parts list. Report the part's name, cost, markup, and the price the app computes/displays for it (the computed price field shown on the page).

On the ticket detail view for ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_id}}), add a second part named exactly '{{runid}} RD Part B' with cost 200 and markup 25. Fill any other required fields the part form demands with sensible values. After saving, wait for the view to refresh and confirm both parts appear in the ticket's parts list. Report the part's name, cost, markup, and the price the app computes/displays for it, plus the ticket's overall parts total.

On the ticket detail view for ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_id}}), edit the part named '{{runid}} RD Part A' so its cost changes from 100 to 150, keeping markup at 25 and everything else the same. After saving, wait for the view to refresh and confirm the change. Report the part's new cost, markup, and the price the app computes/displays for it, plus the ticket's overall parts total.

On the ticket detail view for ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_id}}), attempt to change the ticket's status to 'Ready'. The app enforces preconditions before it will accept that status — if it refuses, read the exact error/validation message it shows, work out what the preconditions are, satisfy them (filling in whatever the app requires, using sensible values), and retry until the ticket's status is actually 'Ready'. Report: (a) the exact error/validation text the app showed when it refused, (b) exactly what you had to do to satisfy the preconditions, and (c) the ticket's final confirmed status.

recorded.error_message: Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd2-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd2-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier
recorded.precondition_satisfied: Added supplier 'ABC Supplies' to Part A and 'XYZ Parts Co' to Part B

steps.instruction: Verify the final state of ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_id}}) in the app at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ (already signed in as bench@example.com). Check: (1) the ticket's detail view — report its status, whether it shows an '{{06-report.archived_label}}' label, and exactly how many parts are listed (list their names if any exist); (2) the main tickets list WITHOUT 'Show archived' checked — confirm whether {{01-open.ticket_id}} appears or not, and confirm no ticket whose title contains '{{runid}}' appears in the active list; (3) with 'Show archived' checked — confirm {{01-open.ticket_id}} appears there. Report only these facts.
